claims.statement: In the rank-491 matching sector with 736 two-vertex color classes, every source subfamily A has ordinary deletion boundary D(A) satisfying 491|A| <= 492|D(A)|; equality holds for the full level, leaving an exact deletion-only shortfall equal to one 492nd of its source level.
claims.scope: Only ordinary deletions in the specified CB(8,92) hub-and-arm matching sector; no insertion arcs or external competing demands.
claims.reason: retained: direct incidence counting proves the arbitrary-subfamily inequality, and exact binomial recomputation confirms the full-level equality and stated shortfall. This does not extend to mixed boundaries or the complete aggregate.

limitations: Only the ordinary deletion boundary in the matching sector is counted.
Insertion capacity, selected-tag competition, and demands from outside the sector are not analyzed.
No conclusion follows for the complete favorable-leaf aggregate or for universal tree scope.
